literal: Shengzong, Part Five
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Five

literal: In the eighteenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, returned and halted at Nanjing, rewarded meritorious officers and soldiers, punished those who disobeyed orders.
idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month the court returned to Nanjing, rewarded officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves, and punished those who had disobeyed orders.

literal: An edict ordered the various armies each to return to their original circuits; in the second month, favored and visited Yanfang Marsh.
idiomatic: An edict ordered all armies to return to their home circuits, and in the second month the court went to Yanfang Marsh.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiwei day, imperial halt at Qingquan Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the fourth summer month the court encamped at Qingquan Marsh.

literal: In the fifth month, on dingyou day, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

literal: In the sixth month, Zubu rebel chieftain Guinian's younger brother Tielabu led his tribes to come and attach; Guinian had nowhere to go, then surrendered; an edict ordered his execution.
idiomatic: In the sixth month Zubu rebel chieftain Guinian's brother Tielabu submitted with his followers; with nowhere to go Guinian surrendered, and an edict ordered his execution.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, imperial halt at Tangquan.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court encamped at Tangquan.

literal: In the ninth month, on yihai new moon, imperial halt at Heihe.
idiomatic: On the yihai new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Heihe.

literal: In winter, eleventh month, on jiaxu new moon, granted Western Peace King Li Jiqian's son Dezhao as Shuofang Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the eleventh winter month Li Jiqian's son Dezhao was appointed military commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

literal: In the twelfth month, the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Uyghur came with tribute.

literal: That year, jinshi Nan Baoshou and three others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year Nan Baoshou and two others passed the examinations.

literal: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinsi day, appointed zhihou langjun class xiangwen Guanyin as King of the Six Xi Divisions.
idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, on xinsi day of the first spring month, zhihou langjun xiangwen Guanyin was appointed king of the Six Xi Divisions.

literal: On jiashen day the Uyghur presented Buddhist monks and famous physicians.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the Uyghur presented Buddhist monks and renowned physicians.

literal: In the third month, on yihai day, Xia State dispatched Li Wengui to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the third month Western Xia sent Li Wengui with tribute.

literal: On yiyou day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported Tangut victory.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported a victory over the Tangut.

literal: On renchen day Empress Xiao was demoted to noble consort because of crime.
idiomatic: On renchen day Empress Xiao was demoted to noble consort on account of misconduct.

literal: Granted Grand Chancellor Han Derang the name Dechang.
idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Han Derang was granted the name Dechang.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yisi day, favored and visited Prince of Wu Longyou's residence to see illness.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the fourth summer month the Emperor visited Prince of Wu Longyou's residence to inquire after his illness.

literal: On bingwu day inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

literal: In the fifth month, on guiyou day, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

literal: On bingxu day enfeoffed Xiao as Qitian Empress.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Xiao was invested as Empress Qitian.

literal: On gengyin day appointed qianzhuaila xiangwen Yelü Wangnu as Prince of Yishi.
idiomatic: On gengyin day qianzhuaila xiangwen Yelü Wangnu was appointed Prince of Yishi.

literal: On xinmao day used green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: In the sixth month, on yisi day, made captured Song general Kang Zhaoyi Zhao Shun Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the sixth month captured Song general Kang Zhaoyi was appointed military commissioner of the Zhaoshun Army.

literal: On wuwu day Xia State memorialized capturing Song Heng, Huan, Qing and three other prefectures; granted edict to praise them.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Western Xia reported the capture of Song's Heng, Huan, Qing, and other prefectures, and an edict was issued to commend them.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, made Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Nugua Southern Chancellery Chancellor.
idiomatic: On bingxu day in the seventh autumn month Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Nugua was appointed Southern Chancellery chancellor.

literal: In the eighth month, on gengxu day, the Dalugu tribe came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the eighth month the Dalugu tribe came with tribute.

literal: In the ninth month, on jisi new moon, inquired after Empress Dowager's health.
idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

literal: On wuzi day imperial halt at Changping.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court encamped at Changping.

literal: On gengyin day Southwestern Pacification Commission reported victory attacking Tuyuhun.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported a victory over the Tuyuhun.

literal: On xinmao day favorably visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court visited Nanjing.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on jihai day, southern campaign.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the tenth winter month a southern campaign was launched.

literal: On renyin day halted at Yanyan Pass.
idiomatic: On renyin day the army halted at Yanyan Pass.

literal: Transferred enfeoffment of Prince of Wu Longyou to Prince of Chu, remaining to guard the capital.
idiomatic: Prince of Wu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Chu and left to guard the capital.

literal: On dingwei day Prince of Liang Longqing commanded vanguard army to advance.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince of Liang Longqing led the vanguard army forward.

literal: On xinhai day shot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: On xinhai day ghost arrows were shot.

literal: On renzi day used green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On renzi day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

literal: On jiayin day Liao army battled Song troops at Suicheng, defeated them.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Liao forces defeated Song troops at Suicheng.

literal: On gengshen day used black and white sheep to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court sacrificed black and white sheep to heaven and earth.

literal: On bingyin day halted at Mancheng, because of mud and mire withdrew army.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the army halted at Mancheng and, bogged down in mud, withdrew.

literal: In the eleventh month, on gengwu day, shot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: On gengwu day of the eleventh month ghost arrows were shot.

literal: On bingzi day Song troops came out of Yukou and Yijin Pass to invade; scout Mouwa and huntsman Zhao Gu defeated them.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Song troops attacked through Yukou and Yijin Pass; scouts Mouwa and gamekeeper Zhao Gu drove them back.

literal: On jimao day viewed fishing at Rumen Marsh.
idiomatic: On jimao day the court watched fishing at Rumen Marsh.

literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou day, the Bigud came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the intercalary month the Bigud came with tribute.

literal: On jiwei day reduced frontier market taxes.
idiomatic: On jiwei day frontier market taxes were reduced.

literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, exempted Nanjing and Ping Prefecture rent and taxes.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the twelfth month rent and taxes at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture were remitted.

literal: In the twentieth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on gengzi day, went to Yanfang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Tonghe, on gengzi day of the first spring month the Emperor went to Yanfang Marsh.

literal: On guichou day five-colored rainbow appeared in the east.
idiomatic: On guichou day a five-colored rainbow appeared in the east.

literal: An edict ordered pacifying the various southwestern submitted tribes.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the pacification of the submitted tribes of the southwest.

literal: On jiayin day Xia State dispatched envoys to present horses and camels.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Western Xia sent envoys presenting horses and camels.

literal: On xinyou day Jurchen chancellor Yilidi came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Jurchen chancellor Yilidi came with tribute.

literal: In the second month, on dingchou day, the Jurchen dispatched their son to come to court.
idiomatic: In the second month, on dingchou day, a Jurchen chieftain sent his son to court.

literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys to congratulate on the victory attacking Song.
idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys congratulating the court on victory over Song.

literal: In the third month, on jiayin day, dispatched Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others on southern campaign.
idiomatic: On jiayin day of the third month Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others were sent on a southern campaign.

literal: On renxu day imperial halt at Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: On renxu day the court encamped at Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on bingyin new moon, Civil Class Grand Guardian Dalidi defeated Song troops at Liangmen.
idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the fourth summer month Civil Class grand guardian Dalidi defeated Song troops at Liangmen.

literal: On jiaxu day Nanjing army commander Xiao Talin broke Song army at Taizhou.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Nanjing army commander Xiao Talin routed Song forces at Taizhou.

literal: On yiyou day southern campaign officers presented captives.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the officers of the southern campaign presented captives.

literal: Granted ranks and rewards in differing amounts.
idiomatic: Titles and rewards were granted according to rank.

literal: On wuzi day the Iron Li dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the Iron Li sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, favored Coal Mountain for summer coolness.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the fifth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: In the sixth month, Xia State dispatched Liu Renxu to report capturing Ling Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the sixth month Western Xia sent Liu Renxu to report the capture of Ling Prefecture.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On dingyou day made Xing Baopu Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Xing Baopu was appointed southern privy commissioner.

literal: On xinchou day Goryeo dispatched envoys to come with tribute of their country's geographical map.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Goryeo sent envoys presenting a geographical map of their realm.

literal: In the ninth month, on guisi new moon, visited Xian Mausoleum, reported southern campaign victory.
idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor visited the Xian Mausoleum and reported the southern victory.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on guihai new moon, returned from Xian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the tenth winter month the court returned from the Xian Mausoleum.

literal: In the twelfth month, the Xi princely establishment's five households and six military commissions presented land of Qijin Mountain, Tuh River valley; granted gold and coins.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Xi princely establishment's five households and six divisions offered land along the Qijin Mountains and the Tuh River; gold and coins were granted in return.

literal: That year, Nanjing and Ping Prefecture wheat showed two ears per stalk.
idiomatic: That year wheat with double ears appeared at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture.

literal: Jinshi Xing Xiang and six others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: Xing Xiang and five others passed the examinations.

literal: In the twenty-first year of Tonghe, spring, first month, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Tonghe, in the first spring month the Emperor went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: In the third month, on renchen day, an edict ordered calendar officials not to record minor matters.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the third month an edict forbade calendar officials from recording trivial events.

literal: On jiawu day audience with Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.

literal: On wuwu day the Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the Iron Li came with tribute.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yichou day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On wuchen day Wuran, Bohai, Aolimi, Yuelidu, Yueliji and five other divisions dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Wuran, Bohai, Aolimi, Yuelidu, Yueliji, and other tribes sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month, Yelü Nugua, Xiao Talin captured Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu.
idiomatic: That month Yelü Nugua and Xiao Talin captured Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu.

literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin new moon, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

literal: On dingsi day Western Peace King Li Jiqian died; his son Dezhao dispatched envoys to come report.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Western Peace King Li Jiqian died; his son Dezhao sent envoys to announce the death.

literal: In the sixth month, on jimao day, posthumously granted Jiqian Palace Secretary; dispatched Western Upper Gate envoy Ding Zhen to offer condolences.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the sixth month Li Jiqian was posthumously made palace secretary, and Western Upper Gate envoy Ding Zhen was sent with condolences.

literal: On xinsi day the Tangut came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the Tangut came with tribute.

literal: On yiyou day Zubu chief Tieluli led the various tribes to come and surrender.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Zubu chief Tieluli submitted with his tribes.

literal: That month, repaired Kedun city.
idiomatic: That month Kedun city was repaired.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day, Zubu, Wugu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengxu day in the seventh autumn month the Zubu and Wugu came with tribute.

literal: On jiayin day made Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu Southern Chancellery Great King.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu was appointed southern chancellery great king.

literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, Zubu Tieluli came to court.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the eighth month Zubu chief Tieluli came to court.

literal: On bingxu day audience with Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.

literal: In the ninth month, on jihai day, Xia State Li Dezhao dispatched envoys to come thank for condolences and posthumous gifts.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the ninth month Western Xia's Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for condolences and posthumous honors.

literal: On guichou day favored Nühe Hot Springs, changed its name to Songlin.
idiomatic: On guichou day the court visited Nühe Hot Springs and renamed them Songlin.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingsi new moon, imperial halt at Qiduh River.
idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Qiduh River.

literal: On wuchen day made Prince of Chu Longyou Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was appointed Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, former Yuyue Yelü Xiuge's son Daoshinu, Gao Jiu and others plotted rebellion, executed.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh month Daoshinu, son of the late yuyue Yelü Xiuge, and Gao Jiu and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

literal: On bingshen day universally registered Southern Chancellery tribal people.
idiomatic: On bingshen day a universal registration of Southern Chancellery tribal households was ordered.

literal: In the twelfth month, on guiwei day, abolished tribute from the three capitals and various circuits.
idiomatic: On guiwei day of the twelfth month tribute missions from the three capitals and all circuits were abolished.

literal: In the twenty-second year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Tonghe, on dinghai day of the first spring month the Emperor went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: In the second month, on yimao new moon, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the second month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingyin day Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Xing Baopu died; court mourning halted three days.
idiomatic: On bingyin day southern privy commissioner Xing Baopu died, and court was suspended for three days.

literal: In the third month, on jichou day, abolished tribal congratulations for Thousand Age Festival and Winter Solstice, Double Fifth tribute.
idiomatic: On jichou day of the third month tribal tribute missions for the Thousand Age Festival, the winter solstice, and the Double Fifth were abolished.

literal: On yiwei day Western Xia Li Dezhao dispatched envoys to present Jiqian's legacy possessions.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Western Xia's Li Dezhao sent envoys presenting Li Jiqian's bequeathed possessions.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, audience with Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the fourth summer month the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.
